pages.title: Golden Ratio Glass
pages.text: Glass made with a transcendental crystal so that its proportions follow the golden ratio at every scale. Each pane is divided into smaller panes in the same ratio, forever. It looks calm and endlessly deep.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first found it in Euclid's Vault and in the wake of a Fractal Wyrm. Later I made my own by fusing a transcendental crystal into containment field glass, and the ratio appeared on its own.

Made in $(item)Geometer's Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Euclid's Automaton, Fractal Wyrm.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Euclids Vault, Geometers Ruin chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Constructions.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Euclid Reliquary, Real Continuum, Transcendent Glass.
